scope: StructureClaw standalone local OpenClaw integration; no Bench changes

implementation.schemas: live registered application tool input schemas, filtered by application RunPolicy
implementation.hostSessionIdentity: SHA256 of trusted host agentId/sessionKey/sessionId and configured installation/workspace
implementation.turnAdmission: first begin via tool; subsequent turns only via operator manage-session.mjs
implementation.redelivery: completed host call IDs and argument digests persist across reloads and turns; duplicates reject without replay
implementation.attachments: existing /api/v1/files/upload; per-conversation attachmentPaths grant; shared vision callback

covers: completed host-call redelivery and changed-argument rejection
trusted host identity and reset isolation
repeated host call cannot repeat operation

packaging.limitation: This scope check does not substitute for prepack/build or an installed-package acceptance run.

boundaries: OpenClaw owns conversation history and its model loop; StructureClaw budgets apply to StructureClaw operations.
The agent cannot initiate subsequent application turns. Trusted operator admission is required until a proven host user-message event is integrated.
Sandboxed host calls are rejected because the local bridge cannot enforce that sandbox.
An admitted operation is awaited; cancellation or a lost response never triggers automatic replay.
A complete Gateway/LLM conversation was not run; actual host plugin loading and real application tool execution were checked separately.
